name: Prime Reciprocal Subset Sum Isomorphism
description: Replaced the bitwise exact-cover condition with an algebraically isomorphic condition: the sum of unit fractions of distinct primes. Each path contributes 1/P_x + 1/P_{k+y} + 1/P_{2k+z} where primes are strictly > k (specifically > 22). By number theory, this sum equals the sum of all 3k prime reciprocals if and only if the chosen primes are exactly the target set without duplicates. Models that pattern-match will attempt to simulate the fraction addition (leading to TLE due to lack of exact-cover pruning, or WA from float precision), while models that reason mathematically will deduce the isomorphism and apply a fast exact-cover algorithm.
